meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Route NanoClaw agent group to local Ollama model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run AI agents locally and cut API costs

howto.what: 装上后，它会把某个 NanoClaw agent 组的请求从 Anthropic API 改为发往本地 Ollama 模型。它会修改容器环境变量、设置模型名、重建并重启服务，然后验证是否生效。前提是 Ollama 已运行且已拉取模型。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 NanoClaw agent 组在本地运行、削减 API 成本，或试用开源权重模型时，它会开始配置。

say.text: 帮我把这个 agent 组切到本地 Ollama 模型。
say.note: 会先确认组名和模型名。

say.text: 改成连本地 Ollama，省点 API 费用。
say.note: 会添加环境变量并可选屏蔽 Anthropic。

howto.what_en: After install, it routes a NanoClaw agent group's requests from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model. It edits container env vars, sets the model name, rebuilds/restarts the service, and verifies. Requires Ollama running with a model pulled.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run an agent group locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group to a local Ollama model.
say_en.note: It will confirm group and model first.

say_en.text: Run my group with Ollama's qwen3-coder, not Anthropic.
say_en.note: Need group name and the model pulled.

say_en.text: Point to local Ollama to save API costs.
say_en.note: Adds env vars and optionally blocks Anthropic.
